head: e5c4b59
summary: Implemented all 23 operations and repaired the conductor-returned shared integration failures. The obsolete HALT marker is removed. Final whole build and format pass; all 721 fast tests and all four heavy feature tests pass. Fixed request-scoped authorization and replaced stale validation count 17 with the measured 29 checks. All 12 semantic scenarios completed with explicit profile/auth setup: 1769 exchanges, exact owned group 323 cases, 39 raw passes and 284 raw failures, no unexpected owned 500. The adjusted 98% replay gate is not claimed. Seven minimal shared repair paths extend the original allocation and are explicitly disclosed. No gate, comparison, certified figure, Python product, remote or other worktree was changed.

deviations.what: Seven minimal shared integration repair paths extend the original allocation.
deviations.why: The repeated conductor instruction to fix the specific returned failures was interpreted as authorizing four shared test files, validator metadata and its runtime binding. Exact paths are in the report. The original mechanical owned-path gate is conservatively not claimed.

deviations.what: The owned API module registers the existing mediator as request-scoped.
deviations.why: Handler-only scopes retained stale root-scoped authorization behavior. The dynamic-policy/reset test exposed this bug and now passes with the same request scope for policy and sources; no second mediator implementation remains.

deviations.what: Run validation metadata reports 29 actual executed SQL checks instead of literal 17 or recorded Python 20.
deviations.why: The authoritative inventory has 20 static checks, seven reference checks and two current-manifest checks. A focused regression counts actual validation SQL through the existing adapter audit hook. No checks were removed and no credit figure was changed.

deviations.what: Replay is complete but remains below the literal threshold.
deviations.why: Raw exact-template results are recorded without disguising error wording, UUID offsets, real durable manifests/program selection or setup dependency failures. No adjusted 98% or improvements-cap result is claimed.

deviations.what: The head field identifies the preceding implementation repair commit.
deviations.why: The final report/status child commit cannot contain its own hash. e5c4b59 contains the production/test repairs and 721-test gate evidence.

findings: Resolved: six shared endpoint-collision cases now exercise real routes; huge-offset tests assert the full-precision offset and honest totals.
Resolved: shared rate-limit and writer/reset tests assert real implemented outcomes rather than placeholder 501.
Resolved: standalone provider validation now composes feature registrations with the same discovery class as the API.
Resolved: scoped handlers alone did not refresh the mediator's authorization behavior; request-scoped mediator fixes policy and source lifetimes together.
Resolved: runtime query metadata was hard-coded to 17; actual inventory and observed executions both total 29.
Final full fast suite: 721 passed, zero failed, across eight projects. Four heavy feature tests passed again in 7m21s.
Final complete semantic run: 12 scenarios, 1769 exchanges, exact owned group 323 cases, 39 raw passes, 284 failing cases and 902 field differences; no unexpected owned 500.
The broader policy-free wrapper uses 398 group cases; it must not replace the exact-template denominator.
The conductor rejects numeric-looking UUID strings and the required repaired never_run counts. These seven cases alone cap literal compatibility at 316/323 (97.83%), even if all other cases passed.
F-18: real successful durable manifests are visible; genuinely never-calculated clients remain 404.
Preview refuses arbitrary client payroll as expressly required, unlike the captured synthetic success under preview-client-refused.

The prior conductor's P2 replies described a one-client CSV fixture; the fresh run explicitly resets P2 and sees four clients. Review per-scenario reset profile selection rather than guessing sources from request IDs.
The rebase replay depends on an unimplemented ReadsCalc units route and substitutes capture-failed; the real recorded unit succeeds in the Gold-only heavy test with matching numbers.
open_questions: How should the conductor apply the permitted incidental-UUID and repaired-manifest policy without treating numeric-looking IDs and honest operational state as changed certified figures?
How should the replay policy account for 29 actual .NET integrity checks versus the recorded Python suite of 20 without removing checks or falsifying metadata?
The capped improvements gate remains unverified; raw error wording and schema-member differences were not blanket-waived.

needs_human.why: The complete replay is below threshold. The task forbids dummy UUID draws and disconnected-manifest behavior, but the conductor rejects those differences as numbers. The implementation and comparisons were not falsified.

needs_human.item: Complete the unowned ReadsCalc setup dependency and verify scenario profile selection.
needs_human.why: Unit rebase cannot receive its recorded unit when setup yields capture-failed; P2 must be reset explicitly rather than using a constant P1 reset URL.

needs_human.item: Atomic override intent and recalculation acceptance.
needs_human.why: Existing ports save override and queue batch in separate transactions. A failed enqueue after save can leave intent without accepted work; unchanged resave currently does not repair it.

Synchronous compute has a 600-second default lease with entry renewal and precommit checks, not periodic heartbeat. Expiry rollback is tested; long-run sizing and live native schema provisioning remain unmeasured.

needs_human.why: Inherited Python-compatible figure-sensitive behavior was preserved. Neither statutory overrides nor multi-program pricing was changed without an owner decision.
